description: This file contains the implementation of an Android Activity class 'Bouncer3' and its inner class 'MyView'. It handles a simple bouncing animation of a bitmap within a custom view, utilizing ObjectAnimator for smooth property animation.

classes.name: Bouncer3
classes.description: An Android Activity managing the UI that displays and animates a bouncing bitmap.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that displays an image and animates its vertical position with ObjectAnimator.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to the activity layout.

methods.name: setupShape
methods.description: Loads the bitmap resource and initializes shape dimensions, also sets up a click listener to start animation.

methods.name: setShapeX
methods.description: Sets the horizontal position of the shape and invalidates the affected region.

methods.name: setShapeY
methods.description: Sets the vertical position of the shape and invalidates the affected region.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size changes in the view, setting the initial position of the shape.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at the current shape position.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts the ObjectAnimator for the shape's Y position, repeating infinitely with reversal.

methods.name: getObjectAnimator
methods.description: Builds and returns an ObjectAnimator targeting the 'shapeY' property.
